description: This PHP class defines a client for the AWS AppFabric service, providing method signatures for various operations such as creating, deleting, fetching, and listing resources related to AppFabric. The class extends AwsClient and includes method annotations for both synchronous and asynchronous calls.

classes.name: AppFabricClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with AWS AppFabric service, providing methods to perform operations such as creating, deleting, and listing AppFabric resources.

methods.name: batchGetUserAccessTasks
methods.description: Retrieves multiple user access tasks in a batch operation.

methods.name: connectAppAuthorization
methods.description: Establishes an authorization connection for an app.

methods.name: getAppAuthorization
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific app authorization.

methods.name: getAppBundle

methods.name: getIngestion
